response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), shares AS (SELECT rating, film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), compared AS (SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
